questions.questionText: Implement binary search in Python. Explain time complexity O(log n) and edge case handling for empty list.
questions.referenceAnswer:
def binary_search(arr, target):
    low, high = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while low <= high:
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        if arr[mid] == target: return mid
        elif arr[mid] < target: low = mid + 1
        else: high = mid - 1
    return -1
Time complexity is O(log n) as search space halves each iteration.
